cohort: 82 patients (57 males, 25 females) aged 14 months to 14 years (mean 4.73 +/- 3.35 years) presenting to a neurosurgery outpatient department in Peshawar, Pakistan.
finding: Most patients with cerebral palsy in this cohort were delivered at a hospital.
mod_finding: Of the hospital deliveries, 5 were by cesarean section and 54 were vaginal deliveries.
gest_age: Preterm delivery was noted but specific gestational ages were not mentioned.
